'''Grendle''' was a [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived on the planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the city of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] where he sold fresh dried [[chokie]] just outside of the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]]. He was related to a fellow merchant, [[Anabar]], but in what way is unknown.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Grendle met the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Jinn was attempting to bet on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]], and asked Grendle about buying a hazardous weapon. Grendle suggested he talk to Anabar.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grendle appears in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. The player, in the guise of Jinn, may chose to talk to Grendle. This article assumes 100% game completion, and the game's strategy guide suggests doing so.
